title: Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines (related to Article 16)
full_text:
■ Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Prevention of Steep Slope Disasters [Attached Table 3] <Amended 2020.9.8>

Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines (related to Article 16)

1. General criteria

(a) The aggravated criteria for imposition of administrative fines according to the number of violations apply where a disposition imposing an administrative fine for the same violation has been received within the preceding one year. In such cases, the period is calculated by reference to the date on which the disposition imposing an administrative fine for the violation was received and the date on which the same violation committed again after that disposition was detected.

(b) Where an aggravated disposition is imposed pursuant to item (a), the level of recurrence applicable to that aggravated disposition shall be the level immediately following that of the disposition imposed before the relevant violation (meaning the highest level where two or more dispositions imposing administrative fines were received within the period under item (a)).

(c) The authority imposing a fine may, in any of the following cases, reduce the amount of the administrative fine under the individual criteria in paragraph 2 by up to one-half. This does not apply to a violator who is in arrears in payment of administrative fines.
1) Where the violation is recognized as resulting from minor negligence or error;
2) Where the substance and severity of the violation are recognized as minor;
3) Where the violator is recognized as having made efforts to rectify or eliminate the unlawful state of affairs;
4) Other cases where reduction is considered necessary in view of the severity of the violation, the motives for the violation, its consequences, etc.

2. Individual criteria

(Unit: 10,000 won)

| Violation | Relevant statutory provision | Amount of administrative fine |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Damaging instruments, equipment, etc. for continuous measurement management under Article 8 (4) of the Act | Article 37 (1) 1 of the Act | 1) First violation: 50; 2) Second violation: 100; 3) Third or subsequent violation: 200 |
| (b) Moving or damaging a danger sign in violation of Article 11 (3) of the Act | Article 37 (1) 2 of the Act | 1) First violation: 50; 2) Second violation: 100; 3) Third or subsequent violation: 200 |
| (c) Failing to conduct a self-administered safety inspection or to take necessary measures, such as emergency measures, under Article 15 (1) of the Act | Article 37 (1) 3 of the Act | 1) First violation: 50; 2) Second violation: 100; 3) Third or subsequent violation: 200 |
| (d) Failing to comply with an order to take safety measures under Article 17 (1) of the Act | Article 37 (1) 4 of the Act | 1) First violation: 50; 2) Second violation: 100; 3) Third or subsequent violation: 200 |
| (e) Refusing an order to evacuate, etc. under Article 18 of the Act | Article 37 (1) 5 of the Act | 1) First violation: 50; 2) Second violation: 100; 3) Third or subsequent violation: 200 |
| (f) Refusing or obstructing temporary use of land, buildings, etc., or alteration or removal of obstacles, under Article 19 of the Act | Article 37 (1) 6 of the Act | 1) First violation: 50; 2) Second violation: 100; 3) Third or subsequent violation: 200 |
| (g) Failing to submit completion documents relating to a steep slope under Article 20 (1) of the Act | Article 37 (1) 7 of the Act | 50 |
| (h) Failing to report the transfer or acquisition of a measurement business, etc., in violation of Article 24 (1) and (3) of the Act (including cases where those provisions apply mutatis mutandis under Article 27 (3) of the Act) | Article 37 (1) 8 of the Act | 50 |
